title: Can an LLM Actually Reason and Program about Neural Network's Weights or is it just memorization on steroids? Exploring "Weight-Space Programming"
abstract: arXiv:2611.08070v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have recently been reported to read and write the raw weights of neural networks directly, a capability termed weight-space programming. We ask whether the reading side of this capability reflects reasoning about weight flows or a combination of local arithmetic at the network's edges and memorized priors over public datasets. We test Claude Opus 5.5 on small convolutional networks of about 125,000 parameters trained on five image datasets, providing every weight as plain text with no tools, no forward passes, and no dataset or class names. The model performs accurate local calculations: batch-normalization statistics lead it to infer about three optimizer steps on networks stopped after three updates, and output-layer sign patterns recover the vehicle/animal split of CIFAR-10. The sessions report reading the first and last layers closely and sampling the middle, and several claims built on partial tracing

translated_title: LLM究竟能真正对神经网络的权重进行推理和编程，还是只是“打了类固醇的记忆”？——探索“权重空间编程”
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）最近被报道能够直接读取和写入神经网络的原始权重，这一能力被称为“权重空间编程”。我们探究这一能力的“读取”端究竟反映了对权重流动的推理，还是网络边缘的局部算术运算与对公开数据集记忆先验的结合。我们在五个图像数据集上训练的约12.5万参数的小型卷积网络上测试了 Claude Opus 5.5，将每个权重以纯文本形式提供，不使用工具、不执行前向传播、不提供数据集或类别名称。该模型能够执行准确的局部计算：批归一化统计量使其能够推断出在三次更新后停止训练的网络大约经历了三次优化器步骤，输出层的符号模式能够恢复 CIFAR-10 的车辆/动物分类。会话记录显示模型紧密读取了第一层和最后一层，并对中间层进行了采样，而且若干声明建立在部分追踪的基础上……
tldr: 论文在无工具、无前向传播的条件下测试LLM读取小型卷积网络原始权重的能力，发现其表现主要源于准确的局部算术计算与对公开数据集的记忆先验，而非对权重流动的真正全局推理。
en_tdlr: Testing an LLM on reading raw neural network weights without tools or forward passes reveals that its "weight-space programming" ability stems mainly from accurate local arithmetic and memorized dataset priors rather than genuine global reasoning about weight flows.
